integrity.computational_status: Finite exact and random numerical checks supplement, but do not replace, analytical proof.
integrity.proof_scope: Complete algebraic global optimization and local stability analysis for real c>=0 and u,v in [0,1]; independent of numerical sampling.

scientific_limitations: Optimizes the sum of two signed grand-canonical stationary currents; no dynamical selection or open-boundary phase-transition theorem.
Existing primary work supplies the stationary product measure and exact cubic flux law; those facts are not new.
Only two identical baseline drifts and equal inhibitory cross-couplings are classified.
A broader optimization theorem could implicitly cover this special case; independent originality assessment has not occurred.
scope: Two equivalent lanes with product-stationary Bernoulli measures, positive equal baseline signed drifts, nonpositive symmetric cross-lane coupling, and independently selected densities in [0,1].
title: Exact throughput-allocation transition in two interacting exclusion lanes
